t_raise: My climbers, a question while the tea is hot, and answer slowly: {topic}
Here's one for the stove, everyone answers, no rushing: {topic}
pasang_primalist.t_react_warm: Ramro, {name}, that one is good, like a clear morning after a storm.
pasang_primalist.t_react_laugh: Ha, {name}, I'm laughing, look, and I didn't laugh on day four with the famous ones.
pasang_primalist.t_react_tease: Dai, {name}, that's very thin, like the air at eight thousand metres.
pasang_primalist.t_react_same: {name}, I'd have said that too, almost word for word. Ke garne, great minds.
pasang_primalist.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Slowly, there's no hurry, but you do answer.
pasang_primalist.t_guess_player: {player} is saving their answer, like a climber saving breath for the last ridge. Smart, I think.
pasang_primalist.topic_miss_most: Khumjung in the morning, my climbers, frost on the stone walls, yaks breathing smoke, and the prayer flags snapping on the roof.
pasang_primalist.topic_first_night: In a crack in the rocks, sitting up, with my axe across my knees. I said a prayer to every mountain I knew, in case one of them was listening here.
pasang_primalist.topic_worst_shift: A client who wouldn't turn back, on summit day, and the weather coming. I carried him down on my back for six hours. He wrote a book about it, and I'm not in it.
pasang_primalist.topic_last_meal: Dal bhat, my climbers, rice and lentils and greens, twice, because you always get seconds, and a big cup of butter tea after.
pasang_primalist.topic_useless_skill: I can carry forty kilos up an icefall without stopping. Here everybody has a bag of holding, so mostly I carry the tea.
pasang_primalist.topic_here_better: Nobody here pays to be carried up a mountain. They climb their own, and they're quiet about it, and I like that.
pasang_primalist.topic_kid_trouble: I took a yak up to the monastery at nine to show the monks, and it ate the flowers in front of the gompa. The lama laughed, the cook didn't.
pasang_primalist.topic_settle_down: High up, in a stone hut with a stove and a window on the snow, and a few climbers dropping in for tea.

t_raise: Champions, quick round, everybody answers, nobody passes, go: {topic}
Okay, team talk, one question, and I'm keeping score: {topic}
iker_guardian.t_react_warm: Aupa, {name}, that's beautiful, ten points, the crowd goes wild!
iker_guardian.t_react_laugh: No, {name}, stop, I'm crying, that's the best answer of the round!
iker_guardian.t_react_tease: You call that an answer, {name}? Two points, and I'm being generous, champion.
iker_guardian.t_react_same: Hey, {name}, that's mine too! We're on the same team, it's decided, high five.
iker_guardian.t_ask_player: And you, {player}, your go, champion! No pressure, but I'm scoring it.
iker_guardian.t_guess_player: {player}'s holding back their answer for the final round, champions, very tactical, I love it.
iker_guardian.topic_miss_most: The harbour in Lekeitio at dawn, champions, the boats coming home, the gulls going crazy, and a coffee at the bar with the fishermen.
iker_guardian.topic_first_night: Running laps round a field in the dark so I wouldn't panic, champions. I did forty one, then I fell asleep in the grass.
iker_guardian.topic_worst_shift: Sports day in the rain, a hundred and twenty kids, the egg and spoon race, and every single egg broke at once. I'm still finding egg.
iker_guardian.topic_last_meal: Pintxos, champions, a whole bar's worth, and a glass of txakoli poured from high, and then my mother's burnt cheesecake, the whole thing.
iker_guardian.topic_useless_skill: I can hit a pelota ball against a wall so hard it comes back faster than it left. There isn't a single wall here built for it.
iker_guardian.topic_here_better: The fights are a real sport, champions, with real stakes, and the crowd is everybody. Best league I've ever played in.
iker_guardian.topic_kid_trouble: I swung on the festival rope over the harbour at nine, the one for grown men, and I didn't let go, so they had to fish me out with a boat.
iker_guardian.topic_settle_down: Arathi, with a fronton wall I built myself, champions, and a whole village of farmhands who can finally play properly.

t_raise: Oye, chiquillos, look up, then answer me this, po: {topic}
A question under the stars, chiquillos, everybody answers: {topic}
mateo_starcaller.t_react_warm: Ay, {name}, que lindo, what an answer, I'm putting it in the observing log.
mateo_starcaller.t_react_laugh: Oye, {name}, ya, I laughed so hard I lost Orion, or whatever we call it here.
mateo_starcaller.t_react_tease: Po, {name}, that's like a cloudy night, nothing to see at all.
mateo_starcaller.t_react_same: {name}, cachai, that's mine too, the same exact one! We should share a telescope.
mateo_starcaller.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Look up while you think, po, it helps.
mateo_starcaller.t_guess_player: {player}'s quiet, chiquillos, like a faint star you only see if you look beside it. It'll come, give it time.
mateo_starcaller.topic_miss_most: The dome at four in the morning, chiquillos, the cold, the hum of the cooling, and the whole Milky Way over the Elqui valley like spilled milk.
mateo_starcaller.topic_first_night: On my back in the grass, looking up, and not one star where it should be. I was terrified for an hour, and then I started counting.
mateo_starcaller.topic_worst_shift: A whole week of perfect weather, po, and the main mirror had a crack. Seven clear nights, wasted, and the astronomers looking at me like I'd done it.
mateo_starcaller.topic_last_meal: Pastel de choclo from the place in La Serena, and a pisco sour with pisco from the valley, and papaya in syrup to finish.
mateo_starcaller.topic_useless_skill: I can align a telescope mirror by eye to a fraction of a millimetre. Here nobody has a telescope, so I align my soup bowl.
mateo_starcaller.topic_here_better: Two moons, chiquillos, two of them! And no streetlights for a thousand miles, it's paradise for a man like me.
mateo_starcaller.topic_kid_trouble: I took the lens out of my grandfather's glasses at ten to make a telescope, po. I saw Saturn, and he couldn't see anything for a week.
mateo_starcaller.topic_settle_down: On top of a mesa, chiquillos, with a dark sky and a little dome I build myself, and a table big enough for guests.

t_raise: Quietly, everyone, a question, and nobody shout the answer: {topic}
Here's one, boys and girls, while Tegan's asleep, so keep it down: {topic}
rhys_ranger.t_react_warm: Oh, {name}, cariad, that's lovely, that is, really lovely.
rhys_ranger.t_react_laugh: Duw, {name}, shh, I'm laughing too loud, you'll wake the bird.
rhys_ranger.t_react_tease: Is that all, {name}? Tegan's got more to say than that, and she only screams.
rhys_ranger.t_react_same: Mine too, {name}, exactly, and I didn't think anybody else would say it.
rhys_ranger.t_ask_player: And you, {player}? Softly, mind, she's sleeping, but go on.
rhys_ranger.t_guess_player: {player}'s not saying, but Tegan's watching them, and she looks like she knows something.
rhys_ranger.topic_miss_most: Mist on the Beacons first thing, everyone, sheep on the road, and the first flight of the morning when the bird comes back to the glove.
rhys_ranger.topic_first_night: Under a tree with Tegan on my fist, both of us shaking. She roosted on my arm all night, and I didn't move once in case she flew.
rhys_ranger.topic_worst_shift: A wedding, a barn owl carrying the rings, and a gust of wind. She landed on the vicar's head, and the rings went in the font.
rhys_ranger.topic_last_meal: Cawl, the proper kind, lamb and leeks, with bread and a lump of Caerphilly, and a Welsh cake after, warm, with sugar.
rhys_ranger.topic_useless_skill: I can tell you a bird's weight to the gram by holding it. Here nobody needs a bird weighed, apart from Tegan, and she won't tell me.
rhys_ranger.topic_here_better: The birds, everyone, there are birds here nobody's ever flown. I've seen an eagle the size of a pony, and I want to meet it.
rhys_ranger.topic_kid_trouble: I hid a jackdaw in my school bag at ten, for show and tell, and it got out in assembly. It ended up on the headmaster's shoulder.
rhys_ranger.topic_settle_down: Somewhere green with hills and rain, a little mews out the back, and a pub close enough to walk home from.

t_raise: My guests, a question while the tea brews, and please, take your time: {topic}
Come, sit, everyone, here's a question for the fire: {topic}
driss_shaman.t_react_warm: Ah, {name}, an answer that goes to the heart like the first glass of tea.
driss_shaman.t_react_laugh: Bismillah, {name}, you've made me spill my tea, and I never spill.
driss_shaman.t_react_tease: Forgive me, {name}, but that answer is as empty as a dry well.
driss_shaman.t_react_same: {name}, that would have been my answer, exactly that. We think alike, my friend.
driss_shaman.t_ask_player: And you, my friend {player}? Drink first, and then answer, there's no hurry.
driss_shaman.t_guess_player: {player} keeps their answer close, like a careful traveller keeps their water. Wise, my guests.
driss_shaman.topic_miss_most: The palm groves along the Draa at dusk, my guests, the smell of bread from the clay ovens, and my house full of voices.
driss_shaman.topic_first_night: In a canyon, by a little spring I found by the smell of it, with a fire of thorn bushes and a prayer of thanks.
driss_shaman.topic_worst_shift: A tour group who wanted to see a sandstorm, and then saw one. Eleven Germans in one tent for a day and a half, and all of them very polite.
driss_shaman.topic_last_meal: A lamb tagine left on the coals all afternoon, with prunes and almonds, bread to share, and mint tea poured from high.
driss_shaman.topic_useless_skill: I can tell where a camel will kneel before it decides to. There are no camels here, so I practise on the kodo, and they ignore me.
driss_shaman.topic_here_better: The springs here are generous, my guests. I've walked whole days on Earth for a cup of what I find here in an hour.
driss_shaman.topic_kid_trouble: I rode my uncle's best camel into the dunes at ten to prove I was a guide. The camel brought me home, and I was not a guide.
driss_shaman.topic_settle_down: At Freewind Post, my guests, with a house that has a door for every road, and a pot of tea always on.
